features: Up to 4 channels on any supported IP camera
Up to 8 MP per channel (depending on camera model); hardware acceleration must be enabled in TRASSIR to display 8 MP video
Up to 2 monitors can be connected
Remote access via TRASSIR Client, Android/iOS app and TRASSIR Cloud; up to 100 connections per server; SSL encryption
Power consumption is up to 30 W without HDD
Net weight omitted: the E13m1 datasheet states 5.5 kg net / 6.2 kg gross, while the earlier E8 datasheet for MiniNVR AnyIP 4/9/16 states 5.5 kg gross (without HDD)
